content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope this email finds you well. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a few minor adjustments before signing. - Regarding the clause stating "After PC Financial confirms that invoice contents are correct, PC Financial shall pay within 45 days after confirming thus.": Payment takes up to 45 days after invoice confirmation, which delays your cash flow beyond standard 30-day terms. I propose that PC Financial shall pay all undisputed invoices within thirty (30) days of receipt. Thank you for your time and understanding. Best regards.
